adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no existing embed is found (`topic_id` nil), the code unconditionally does `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ... embed_url: embed_url)` on every request and immediately renders `loading`—there is no server-side rate limit or de-duplication at enqueue time. The only throttle shown is in `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?`, but that runs inside the background job (`Jobs::RetrieveTopic#execute`) and therefore does not prevent unbounded job creation/queue growth; it only short-circuits the fetch after the job has already been enqueued and picked up. Additionally, `ensure_embeddable` relies on `request.referer` host matching `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, which is a client-supplied header and can be trivially spoofed, so an attacker can pass the check and spam `/embed/best?embed_url=...` to enqueue arbitrarily many jobs (and can vary `embed_url` to avoid the per-URL Redis key entirely).
